support.criterion: at least two cycles of the low band edge on every axis; heuristic, not a resolution guarantee
support.bounds: complete finite source samples only; no padding or wrap

band.convention: low <= exact DFT radial frequency < high

grid.centers: integer window starts + (support - 1)/2; no half-cell offset

warnings: Regional band power is not a unique local wavelength, propagation direction, phase, Hamiltonian energy or optical light.
Finite 3D support and Hann broadening cause leakage; band edges select exact discrete Fourier radii, not ideal physical passbands.
Overlapping windows are correlated. Only listed centers are measured; palette, opacity and display interpolation are presentation.
Unavailable centers have null power, not zero. No periodic boundary wrapping or partial window is used.
Unresolved band: fewer than two cycles of its low edge fit on at least one axis. Preserve needed support and reduce center count for a smaller batch; this heuristic is not a resolution guarantee.

provenance.power_meaning: sum of exact-band window-weighted mean-square residual powers; not Hamiltonian energy
provenance.geometry_policy: data_local; identity linear data_to_world; translation changes world centers only
provenance.unit_policy: canonical position_unit and channel_metadata only; no automatic conversion
provenance.batching: one native selected-channel decode; one sequential FFT workspace; no display-preview input

worker.policy: private file transport; one computation at a time

model_a.scope: Unmodified owned Python worker, native t20, 128-cube support, 1/4/9 centers, exact band [.05,.15); no GUI/GPU/solver
model_a.independence: Synthetic tests use independent full complex direct DFT. Model A comparison checks map against individual #413 operation; their production FFT kernel is shared.
model_a.cache_note: First request verifies the full committed prefix. OS disk cache is uncontrolled; subsequent requests use the identity-checked worker memo.
model_a.timing_note: Roundtrip includes source/compute, IPC and polling; it is not pure IPC or native plot latency. Calculation timing includes window, FFT and normalization; reduction is reported separately.

limitations: No native UI, viewport FPS, GPU memory or packaged measurement
No solver, all-frame map, scientific source copy or alternate Model A capture
CPU FFT cancellation occurs at bounded checkpoints; an individual NumPy FFT call is not interruptible
